TRAVELER TWIN · SOFT CONTEXT

Personalization with a boundary.

Explicit intent wins. Learned evidence helps rank a plan, but never expands budget, payment, commitment, or autonomy authority.

EXPLICIT
STEP_FREE_REQUIRED

From this Journey request

Applied directly to the current plan objective.
Capability needs

No explicit capability facts recorded.

LEARNED_SOFT
No learned signals

From completed Journey outcomes

Ranking input only · expires with evidence freshness.
Learned capability state

Hard accessibility needs are never inferred from behavior.

Authority boundary

Twin evidence can improve a route or hotel ranking. It cannot create a booking, spend money
